subject: Generate and save series of plots with common structure?

messages.author: 834e57a4194bb8dc
messages.subject: Generate and save series of plots with common structure?
parts:
Consider a data frame with the following structure:

 

df1 <- data.frame(y = runif(10),x1 = runif(10), x2 = runif(10), x3 = runif(10))

 

Is there a way to generate, for example, all the scatterplots of the x’s with y and write them out?

 

Thanks!

Art

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Generate and save series of plots with common structure?
parts:
On 2/22/2013 3:08 PM, Art Burke wrote:
> Consider a data frame with the following structure:
>
> df1 <- data.frame(y = runif(10),x1 = runif(10), x2 = runif(10), x3 = runif(10))
>
> Is there a way to generate, for example, all the scatterplots of the
> x's with y and write them out?
>
> Thanks!
> Art

Is this what you are looking for?

library("reshape2")
df2 <- melt(df1, id.var="y")
library("ggplot2")
ggplot(df2, aes(value, y)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~variable)

--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University
